sql: SELECT bucket,count(*),sha2(concat_ws('',sort_array(collect_list(row_digest))),256) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce((true) AND (id-16000001)>=40000000 AND (id-16000001)<48000000,false) THEN cast(((id-16000001)-40000000) DIV 100000 AS BIGINT) ELSE cast(-1 AS BIGINT) END bucket,sha2(concat(CASE WHEN source_system IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_system AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_system AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN rel_type_id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(rel_type_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(rel_type_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_type IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_type AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_type AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN target_type IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(target_type AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(target_type AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN target_id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(target_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(target_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN entity_version IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(entity_version AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(entity_version AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END),256) row_digest FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.append_edge_adjacency_forward_r643 VERSION AS OF 12) GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

label: complete-endpoint-closure
sql: WITH nodes AS (SELECT source_system,type_id,id FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.growth_object_current_r236 VERSION AS OF 6 UNION ALL SELECT source_system,type_id,id FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.append_node_object_current_r643 VERSION AS OF 15),endpoints AS (SELECT source_system,source_type type_id,source_id id FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.append_edge_edge_current_r643 VERSION AS OF 11 UNION ALL SELECT source_system,target_type type_id,target_id id FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.append_edge_edge_current_r643 VERSION AS OF 11),missing AS (SELECT e.* FROM endpoints e LEFT ANTI JOIN nodes n ON e.source_system=n.source_system AND e.type_id=n.type_id AND e.id=n.id) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM endpoints),(SELECT count(*) FROM missing),(SELECT count_if(source_system IS NULL OR type_id IS NULL OR id IS NULL) FROM endpoints)
